description:
Location: Ghent, Belgium
 Company: LexisNexis Legal & Professional 
   
 About LexisNexis 
   
 LexisNexis Legal & Professional serves customers in more than 150 countries and is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools. We help legal, compliance, government, and business professionals make better decisions, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. 
   
 About the Role 
   
 We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong QA Coaching skills to join our collaborative engineering team in Belgium. 
   
 This is a unique opportunity for a developer who enjoys both building software and improving quality practices across the team. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure high-quality, reliable releases while helping establish a strong testing culture. 
   
 Key Responsibilities 

 Technical Foundation 

Understand and navigate our full-stack architecture, including frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
Review code through Git/GitHub pull requests to assess code quality and test coverage.
Support developers in debugging and problem-solving activities.
Leverage AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate code reviews, troubleshooting, and development workflows.

 Quality Assurance 

Design, write, and maintain test plans and test cases.
Perform manual, exploratory, and validation testing.
Establish and maintain lightweight testing standards, checklists, and QA best practices.
Monitor features in production and assist with troubleshooting and issue investigation.
Ensure testing activities are incorporated throughout the development lifecycle.

 Coaching & Collaboration 

Coach developers on testing techniques and quality-focused development practices.
Review test coverage, identify gaps, and highlight potential edge cases.
Explain testing rationale through code reviews, pair programming, and collaborative sessions.
Partner with Product Managers and Designers to define clear acceptance criteria and testable requirements.
Promote a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement across the engineering team.

 What We're Looking For 

Experience as a Full Stack Developer with solid knowledge of modern web application architectures.
Strong understanding of software quality assurance principles and testing methodologies.
Experience reviewing code and working with Git/GitHub workflows.
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple layers of an application.
Excellent communication and coaching skills.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Passion for quality, collaboration, and continuous learning.

 Why Join LexisNexis? 

Work on innovative products that make a meaningful impact globally.
Be part of a collaborative and inclusive team culture.
Access continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Benefit from the resources and stability of a global organization while contributing to a high-performing local team. 
   
 Ready to help us build high-quality software and empower teams to deliver excellence? Apply today and join LexisNexis in Belgium. 


Primary Location Base Pay Range: Belgium - Ghent €54,400 - €90,800. 





This role is covered by the PC 200/ CP 200 Paritair Comité (Dutch) / Commission Paritaire (French)
